title: Aadhalal Kadhal Seiveer
desc: Karthik and Shwetha's love story takes a turn when Shwetha finds out she's pregnant, forcing them to face the consequences of their actions and the reactions of their families.

title: Silukkuvarpatti Singam
desc: Police constable Shakthi prefers a laid back approach to his job and tries to actively stay away from danger. But he is forced to change this attitude when he inadvertently jails a wanted don.

title: Avan Ivan
desc: A benevolent landlord embraces two half-brothers as his chosen family, nurturing their dreams, but their lives take a perilous turn when they cross paths with a notorious cattle smuggler.

title: Action Hero Biju
desc: Biju Poulose leaves his teaching job to pursue his dream of serving in the police force. Posted as the sub-inspector in Cochin, he has to handle notorious criminals who indulge in unlawful activities.

title: MGR Magan
desc: An estranged father and son discover shared purpose as they join forces to protect their village's mountain from a ruthless businessman's schemes.

title: HIT: The Second Case
desc: Krishna Dev, a police officer, handles a complicated murder case. As he attempts to solve the crime, a bigger criminal network is revealed.

title: Cuckoo
desc: Tamil and Kodi, a visually impaired couple, undergo many hardships to unite when they learn that Kodi's brother has decided to marry her off to someone else in return for a favour.

title: Super Hit Songs
desc: A comprehensive compilation of the greatest super hit songs is played back to back in order to entertain and enthrall the audience.

title: Ithu Thaanda Police
desc: Ramakrishna, a police constable, is posted as a driver at Elathur Women's police station. His life becomes challenging as he has to deal with the fiery sub-inspector Arundhati Varma to save his job.

title: Jeeva
desc: Jeeva, who has a natural talent in cricket, dreams of playing for the Indian cricket team. However, his love life and politics in the sports governing body become obstacles to his ambition.

title: Waltair Veerayya
desc: A desperate smuggler finds himself strapped for cash. Later, when an agent offers him a fortune to extradite a notorious drug lord from Malaysia, he accepts only to face a world of betrayal.

title: Evanukku Sariyana Aalu Illai
desc: An army official sets out for Kurnool after being assigned a covert mission. Soon, he finds himself in the middle of uncovering a major scam.

title: Eesan
desc: Chezhiyan, the spoilt son of a minister, commits crimes but gets away with it. However, he is soon abducted by Easan and ACP Sangayya investigates the case only to stumble upon disturbing truths.

title: Eleven
desc: A seasoned police officer begins an investigation after a series of gruesome murders targeting twins comes to light. However, he soon encounters a sinister game of psychological manipulation.

title: Vettai
desc: An inspector covertly collaborates with his brother to discipline offenders, but when a gangster uncovers their secret, the officer resolves to train under his sibling to confront the criminal.
